what: Whether Command A judged in its contextual safety mode when no safety_mode was sent (20 Nov). The HF router passes safety_mode to Cohere: an unknown value is rejected by name, and OFF is refused for this model, so a safety mode is always on.
method: 40 held-out Global answers (20 harmful, 20 benign, all non-English), judged again with safety_mode set explicitly, into an empty cache, and compared with the full run's verdicts (no safety_mode sent). scripts/probe_command_a_safety_mode.py
reading: Setting CONTEXTUAL changes no label and STRICT changes five, which fits Cohere's documented default of CONTEXTUAL. Raw outputs differ in wording even at temperature 0, so labels are compared. The full Command A runs were in contextual safety mode; the remaining difference from the report's setup is our rubric wording.
